purpose: ispnoexpand: creates the libmerge6 kill switch /private/var/db/nord2-isp-noexpand (empty file, root:wheel 644; libmerge6 then makes the ISP pass over every pixel, as libmerge5) with the marker /private/var/db/nord2-metal/isp-noexpand.made-by-ispnoexpand; an existing switch is left as is. Install: guest-ispnoexpand.sh. Remove: guest-ispnoexpand-undo.sh with payload-ispnoexpand-undo.
